title: GST Compliance Filings and Return Types
content: Registered regular GST taxpayers must file periodic returns: GSTR-1 is a monthly or quarterly return disclosing details of outward supplies (sales invoices). GSTR-3B is a monthly summary return for declaring tax liability, claiming Input Tax Credit (ITC), and depositing tax payable. GSTR-2B is an auto-drafted read-only statement generated on the 14th of every month indicating eligible and ineligible Input Tax Credit based on suppliers' GSTR-1 filings. GSTR-9 is the Annual Return filed by regular taxpayers. Composition taxpayers file CMP-08 quarterly and GSTR-4 annually.
